title: Toric Landau-Ginzburg models in threefold divisorial contractions
summary: We investigate quantum periods and toric Landau-Ginzburg models under divisorial contractions of terminal Fano threefolds. Let $g:Y \rightarrow X$ be a divisorial contraction between $\mathbb{Q}$-factorial Fano threefolds with ordinary terminal singularities and $E$ be the exceptional divisor.
